Approval must occur in one of 20 the following ways: 21 (1) Approval by the board at the next board of supervisors 22 meeting following the meeting for which the proceedings are to 23 be published. 24 (2) Approval by the chairperson of the board of supervisors 25 prior to the meeting following the meeting for which the 26 proceedings are to be published. 27 Sec. 4. As used in this subsection , “summary” 35 -1- SF 2341.3327 (1) 91 ms/js 1/ 2 #1. means a narrative description of the resolution setting forth 1 the main points of the resolution in a manner calculated to 2 inform the public in a clear and understandable manner the 3 meaning of the resolution and to provide the public with 4 sufficient notice of the policy stated or action to be taken, 5 as resolved by the board in the resolution. The narrative 6 description shall include the title of the resolution, an 7 accurate and intelligible synopsis of the essential elements 8 of the resolution, a statement that the description is a 9 summary, the location and the normal business hours of the 10 office where the full text of the resolution may be inspected, 11 and the effective date of the resolution. Legal descriptions 12 of property set forth in a resolution shall be described in 13 full.
